import struct
data = open('src/test/OpenEXRTest/comp_piz.exr','rb').read()
i=8
attrs={}
while i < len(data):
    j = data.index(b'\x00', i); name=data[i:j]; i=j+1
    if name==b'': break
    k=data.index(b'\x00',i); typ=data[i:k]; i=k+1
    sz=struct.unpack('<I',data[i:i+4])[0]; i+=4
    val=data[i:i+sz]; i+=sz
    attrs[name]=val
dw=struct.unpack('<iiii', attrs[b'dataWindow'])
h = dw[3]-dw[1]+1
off_start = i
print('header end', i, 'height', h)
# PIZ is scanline, lines_per_chunk = 32 for piz
# offset table has ceil(h/32) entries
import math
nchunks = math.ceil(h/32)
print('nchunks', nchunks)
off_table=[]
for c in range(nchunks):
    o = struct.unpack('<Q', data[off_start+c*8: off_start+c*8+8])[0]
    off_table.append(o)
print('first offsets', off_table[:5])
print('chunk0 offset', off_table[0])
# chunk data: size(4) + compressed data
co = off_table[0]
print('chunk0 at', co)
print('chunk0 size field', struct.unpack('<I', data[co:co+4])[0])
print('chunk0 first 40 bytes', data[co:co+40].hex())
"
